$comment: Vulnerabilities govulncheck reports that this project has assessed and accepted.
An entry needs a reason that explains why the code is not reachable or not at
risk, and a review date. scripts/security/vulncheck.py fails the build on any
finding that is not listed here, and also on any entry whose review date has
passed, so an acceptance cannot be forgotten.
Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version exists: the gate does not check that.

go.summary: Moby AuthZ plugin bypass via oversized request bodies
go.reason: Daemon-side: the flaw is in Moby's API server AuthZ middleware. GoFi links only the Docker client and api/types packages (verify with `go list -deps ./... | grep docker/docker`); it never imports api/server, middleware or plugin. The advisory carries no symbol data, so govulncheck can only flag the whole module. No fixed version is published for the Go module.

go.summary: Moby off-by-one in plugin privilege validation
go.reason: Daemon-side: the flaw is in Moby's plugin install privilege check. GoFi never installs Docker plugins and does not import the plugin packages. Same module-level false positive as GO-2026-4887. No fixed version is published for the Go module.
